facts.value: Erasmus+ DELTA focuses on supporting the professional development of all staff who teach in Irish higher education, with a particular focus on the enhancement of teaching and learning within and between disciplines.

metadata.chunk_title: Erasmus+ Delta Scholarships + Process for UL Staff

facts.value: Funding is allocated on a first come basis.
The maximum duration is 5 working days excluding travel time.
Obtain permission from the organization you will visit and your line manager.
Create a programme of activities in collaboration with the host organization.
Complete the Staff Mobility agreement for Teaching or Training.
The partner institution will sign your agreement, and your line manager signs off on the quality of the agreement.
Complete this at least 5 weeks prior to your intended travel date.
80% of your grant payment will be made within 30 calendar days after the signature of the agreement by both parties.
Keep your boarding cards and submit copies along with a signed and stamped Certificate of Attendance from your host within 10 days of your return.
Your final grant payment will be made within 10 working days on receipt of all documentation.
Complete the Acknowledgement of Grant Receipt form and return it after the final grant payment is made.

facts.value: If you are interested in completing an Erasmus+ EU Staff Training mobility, attending a Staff Week organised by one of UL's partner universities may be a good option. Staff Weeks are usually designed to give an overview of the host university's institution and departments, while bringing together teaching and non-teaching staff to share ideas and potentially establish connections for future collaboration.
